statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail moves to 15 inside the low band as NQ at 30,310.75 holds the upper half of its overnight band after a marginal new high at 30,342.50, an incremental firming of directional tilt that is not yet accompanied by volatility expansion, cross-asset alignment or failed retracements.
recommendation: Overnight conditions remain consistent with a mean-reverting regime carrying a modest upward tilt. NQ trades near 30,310.75, about 0.56% above the 30,141.75 prior settlement, in the upper half of a 30,163.75-30,342.50 band whose top was marginally extended during the last hour. The incremental change since the prior assessment is that price has moved from mid-band to the upper half and set a marginal new high, which is the one genuine Tail input; it is offset by a VIX day range of only 14.91-15.00, by crude easing off its session highs with WTI near 82.61 and Brent near 89.26, and by continued cross-asset disagreement, with S&P 500 futures around +0.13% and Dow futures negative against NQ leading. Tail therefore rises one point and Stress eases two. The mapped policy state is EA_ON, with a narrow danger window retained around the US cash open and its first hour, where opening-auction continuation would first become observable.
headline: Nasdaq-100 futures near 30,310.75 hold the upper half of their overnight band after a marginal new high at 30,342.50, with the VIX pinned near 14.93 and crude easing from its session highs
body: NQ futures trade near 30,310.75 as of 11:35Z, up 169.00 points or about 0.56% on the 30,141.75 prior settlement, inside an observed overnight band of roughly 30,163.75-30,342.50. The incremental development since the prior assessment is positional rather than structural: price has moved from mid-band to the upper half and the band top has been marginally extended from 30,331.50 to 30,342.50, while the band base is unchanged. That is a modest firming of the directional tilt and the one genuine Tail input in this hour. It is not yet a mean-reversion failure. The band remains narrow at about 0.59%, retracements through the European morning have been completing rather than failing, and the marginal new high has not been followed by the repeated extension that characterises a pathological path. Volatility corroborates that reading: the VIX is near 14.93 against a 14.25 prior close, but its entire day range is 14.91-15.00, which is a pinned rather than expanding volatility surface. The energy channel has eased. WTI is near 82.61, up about 0.26%, and Brent near 89.26, up about 0.83%, both below the levels of the prior hour as investors weigh stalled Washington-Tehran negotiations against reports that Iran and Oman are moving closer to an arrangement on managing the Strait of Hormuz. The underlying discontinuity is unresolved, with Hormuz transit reported at five commodity vessels on Saturday against 31 the previous weekend, but the premium is fading at the margin and is not transmitting into equity volatility. Cross-asset confirmation remains absent. Delayed context shows S&P 500 futures around +0.13% and Dow futures around -0.13% against NQ leading, so the advance is index-specific rather than a broad risk-on impulse. Latest-session internals are split in the same way, with all seven tracked semiconductors positive and a mean gain near 1.65%, led by Micron, against negative application and infrastructure software; that is rotation, not aligned breadth, and megacap dispersion near 0.57% with six of eight positive says the same. Rates are steady, with the H.15 curve as of August 13 at 4.15% on the 2-year and 4.63% on the 10-year, and Treasury futures only marginally bid. The macro backdrop is the cooling-economy narrative established by Friday's University of Michigan preliminary August sentiment reading of 51 against a 55 consensus and the largest monthly retail sales decline in more than a year, which has reduced September Fed hike pricing. Today's calendar is light and none of it has printed at the assessment cutoff: the Empire State survey at 12:30Z with consensus near 11 against a 15.60 prior, the NAHB Housing Market Index at 14:00Z with consensus near 33, and TIC flows at 20:00Z. Housing Starts and Building Permits follow on Tuesday and FOMC minutes on Wednesday at 18:00Z are the week's structural checkpoint, with Home Depot, Lowe's and Walmart reporting through the week. Tail rises to 15 on the upper-band positioning while remaining well inside the low band, because the no-retracement path is not observed and no independent amplifier is aligned with it. Stress eases to 64 as crude retreats from its highs and volatility stays pinned. Confidence is 84 on fresh, mutually corroborating price, volatility, rates, energy and calendar evidence, with one reputable news source unavailable during the run and its content substituted from primary alternatives.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding clock-hours carry a published Claude assessment. Tail stayed inside the low band for the entire window, ranging from 12 to 17, with the mapped policy state EA_ON throughout. Stress peaked at 82 during Sunday's US-hours window while Gulf conflict and crude headlines dominated, then decayed steadily to 66 by the final hour as the tape compressed and crude faded from its highs. Confidence improved from 75 to 83 as live futures pricing, volatility, rates and calendar evidence became progressively better corroborated, with a temporary dip to 68 across the thin weekend evening hours. Dominant mode was mixed through the active sessions and normal across the quiet overnight stretch, and at no point in the window was a persistent no-retracement path observed.
outlookSummary: The conditional path keeps Tail inside the low band across all 24 forecast hours, with the mapped policy state EA_ON throughout. Conditional risk holds at 15 in the current hour, lifts to 16 into the 12:00Z hour containing the Empire State survey, and peaks at 17 across the 13:00Z-14:00Z window covering the US cash open, the opening auction and the NAHB release, which is the point at which opening-auction continuation with shallow pullbacks would first become observable. It decays through the US afternoon as opening imbalances clear, lifts again to 16 into the 19:00Z power hour where late continuation or reversal can be directionally efficient, then falls to a window minimum of 12 across the thin post-close and Asian hours before drifting back to 15 into Tuesday's European session ahead of the 12:30Z housing releases. Stress eases from 64 to a low of 59 overnight, with a temporary lift to 70 across the US open window, and Confidence declines from 84 to 70 as the horizon extends beyond any live price-path evidence. The marginal new high is the one current amplifier and is treated as positional rather than structural; the unresolved Hormuz situation remains a conditional Stress channel rather than an observed equity price-path breakdown. Every hourly score is conditional risk and does not assert that future structure has already been observed.
